title: Baseline mapper-0 conversion and patchability proof
description: Establish a clean, reproducible baseline for current mapper-0/NROM support before adding new mappers. Use bundled test ROMs and a known mapper-0 commercial ROM such as Super Mario Bros. to verify conversion output and determine whether the SNES output is practical to inspect/patch.
design: Keep this limited to existing mapper-0 behavior. Record exact ROM/header details, Docker command, generated output path, and any emulator/debugger observations needed to evaluate patchability.
acceptance_criteria: Docker conversion succeeds for an existing test ROM and at least one known mapper-0 game. Generated output artifacts are documented. A small patchability assessment is recorded in the issue notes/comments.

title: Add mapper 2 / UxROM support using Mega Man 1
description: Implement the first bank-switching mapper tier using `Mega Man (U).nes` as the representative target. This should introduce real mapper semantics rather than bypassing the mapper rejection.
design: Model UxROM PRG bank switching with a fixed upper bank and switchable lower bank. Identify every current fixed-address assumption in mapper/disassembly/recompilation paths before mutation.
acceptance_criteria: `Mega Man (U).nes` is accepted as mapper 2, conversion reaches a defined milestone, and mapper-0 baseline remains green. Limitations and remaining runtime failures are recorded with evidence.

title: Add mapper 1 / MMC1 support using Mega Man 2
description: Implement MMC1 support after mapper 2 groundwork. Use `Mega Man 2 (U).nes` as the representative target for stateful serial mapper register behavior.
design: Implement MMC1 shift-register writes, PRG banking mode handling, CHR RAM/ROM handling as required by the target, and mirroring state where it affects generated output.
acceptance_criteria: `Mega Man 2 (U).nes` is recognized as mapper 1, reaches a documented conversion/runtime milestone, and mapper-0 plus mapper-2 regressions are checked.

title: Attempt Crystalis as the post-MMC3 integration target
description: Use `Crystalis.nes` only after the mapper ladder has enough evidence. Treat it as an integration target for MMC3 plus battery/SRAM and game-specific runtime assumptions.
design: Header profile from local ROM: mapper 4, 256KB PRG, 128KB CHR, battery flag set, horizontal mirroring. Start with conversion acceptance, then title/intro/runtime milestones, then playability.
acceptance_criteria: Crystalis has a same-run evidence bundle for the reached milestone. Success is not claimed from header acceptance or output generation alone; record concrete runtime/playability frontier and remaining blockers.

title: Add first MMC3 / mapper 4 support using Mega Man 3
description: Implement the first MMC3 target using `Mega Man 3 (U) [!].nes`. This is the main bridge toward Crystalis-class games.
design: Add MMC3 PRG banking, CHR banking, mirroring/control register behavior, and the minimum IRQ model needed to reach useful milestones. Keep feature flags or diagnostics explicit where behavior is incomplete.
acceptance_criteria: `Mega Man 3 (U) [!].nes` is accepted as mapper 4 and reaches a documented milestone beyond header parsing. Existing mapper-0/2/1 checks remain usable.

title: Expand upernes mapper support through Mega Man ladder to Crystalis
description: Roadmap epic for expanding upernes from mapper-0/NROM conversion toward practical mapper 2, MMC1, MMC3, and Crystalis support. Treat this as an incremental platform effort: prove each mapper tier with representative ROMs before attempting Crystalis.
design: Use the Mega Man series as the primary progression: baseline mapper 0 first, Mega Man 1 for mapper 2/UxROM, Mega Man 2 for MMC1, Mega Man 3 for first MMC3, Mega Man 4-6 for broader MMC3 validation, then Crystalis for MMC3 plus battery/SRAM complexity.
acceptance_criteria: All child issues are either completed or explicitly superseded with evidence. Crystalis is not treated as successful until the generated SNES output reaches a meaningful playable milestone, not merely conversion output.

title: Document Docker-first and background subagent workflow
description: Update repository agent instructions so future work uses Docker as the always-preferred toolchain path and runs subagents in the background for Docker-based work.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md explicitly states Docker is the default/required build, conversion, and validation path unless the task is specifically changing local toolchain setup, and states that Docker-based work should use background subagents for parallel/asynchronous investigation or validation where practical.
close_reason: Updated AGENTS.md with Docker-first workflow and background/asynchronous subagent guidance.

title: Fix build.sh test-ROM loop treating makeall.sh as a directory
description: During Docker validation, `bash ./build.sh` built the NES test ROMs and the C++ binary, but emitted `./build.sh: line 17: cd: /opt/workspace/rom/nes/dev/makeall.sh: Not a directory` followed by `make: *** No rule to make target 'clean'. Stop.` and `make: *** No rule to make target 'all'. Stop.` The script enumerates `ls rom/nes/dev` and assumes every entry is a directory, but `makeall.sh` is a file.
design: Change the test-ROM loop to iterate only directories or otherwise skip non-directory entries. Preserve current successful build behavior for test ROM directories and source/Makefile.
acceptance_criteria: `bash ./build.sh` in the Docker toolchain completes without attempting to cd into `rom/nes/dev/makeall.sh`, and still produces `bin/binl64/upernes`.

title: Broaden MMC3 validation with Mega Man 4-6
description: Validate and harden MMC3 support against `Mega Man 4 (U).nes`, `Mega Man 5 (U).nes`, and `Mega Man 6 (U).nes` after the first Mega Man 3 milestone.
design: Use the differences across Mega Man 4-6 to expose larger PRG sizes, CHR-ROM versus CHR-RAM behavior, and late-series MMC3 assumptions. Track per-game gaps separately if needed.
acceptance_criteria: Each Mega Man 4-6 ROM has a recorded mapper/header profile, conversion/runtime milestone, and failure mode or pass evidence. Regressions against Mega Man 3 are checked.

title: Design NES battery/SRAM mapping for SNES output
description: Design and implement the save-RAM path needed before Crystalis can be treated as a serious target. Crystalis has the iNES battery flag set, so mapper 4 alone is insufficient.
design: Map NES PRG-RAM/save semantics onto an appropriate SNES SRAM layout. Document file/emulator expectations and make save behavior testable independently of a full Crystalis playthrough.
acceptance_criteria: There is a documented SRAM mapping design, code path, and a bounded validation artifact showing that generated SNES output can preserve/read save-like state or a clear blocker issue is filed.
